items.title: Nancy Wilson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Even Shearing came on board for an orchestration... We did – when we worked at Carnegie Hall

ctx.x: Even Shearing came on board for an orchestration.
Hello Young Lovers, George Shearing. Beautiful charts. I’m trying to remember who worked with him, who wrote the charts out. I can see him, but I can’t call his name.
